thread:
alex: heads-up: canary p99 host CPU spiked ~2.2x this morning on streaming workload
maria: any perf traces yet?
sam: uploaded a trace bundle to perf: rv-1865559999 (private)
alex: quick profile shows hotspots: token normalize -> rust shim -> grpc writev -> header parse -> kvcache evict_check
alex: flame excerpt:
```
  39.8%  token::normalize
  22.1%  rust_shim::process_chunk
  13.4%  grpc::writev
   9.6%  proto::parse_headers
   8.0%  kvcache::evict_check
```
irina: writev + parse_headers -> HPACK/fragment work. also seeing lots of tiny frames (smallwrite ratio high)
cheng: we rolled kernel-scorer tweak yesterday that prefers int8 for short sequences when batch<3
maria: scorer change aimed to save GPU tokens but might fragment host-side batches
sam: repro locally with streaming harness: enabling scorer-v4 doubles small-write count and shifts p99 host CPU up ~2x
alex: hypothesis: GPU win on average, but increased request fragmentation increases host overhead (writev, parse, kvcache) -> net tail regression
cheng: short-term mitigations: revert scorer-v4 on canary; enable micro-coalescer for grpc writes; throttle kvcache eviction background loops
maria: can we gate micro-coalescer behind a canary flag? want to validate without global risk
alex: rolled revert + canary micro-coalesce flag; p99 improved within 10m
perf-bot: regression alert: host_cpu_p99 rose 120% at 2026-03-23T15:02Z, auto-closed after revert at 2026-03-23T15:14Z
sam: reproduced artifacts uploaded to INF-4823; prepping a small repro PR with perf graphs and harness
cheng: long-term: extend kernel-scorer cost model with a host_write_penalty term; add simulator that models parse + write costs when evaluating policy changes
irina: also add metric for small-write ratio, avg writev latency, and header-parse CPU so perf alerts can trigger early
maria: agreed. creating INF-4830 to own observability additions and INF-4823 for scorer work. assigning cheng/sam for scorer and sam/irina for observability
sam: note: micro-coalescer heuristic: coalesce adjacent small frames if downstream write latency > 0.7ms or small-write_ratio > 0.4 — reduced tail in local runs
alex: next steps: keep revert on canary until host_penalty scorer lands; run A/B on micro-coalesce; follow up with a short postmortem if stable\maria: thanks team. good triage. :thumbsup:
